acceptance: uv run -- python -m pytest -q -n 0 tests/unit/core/results/test_database.py passes with no teardown error.
The leak guard still catches environment changes made by BenchBox code or tests.
The fix names snowflake.connector.options as the source.
context: Found 2026-10-05 while checking local-only test failures during the v0.4.2 release. Separately, running the suite with -o addopts="" drops the -p _benchbox_pytest_xdist_safety plugin and makes test_init_default_path fail its session-HOME assertion; that is expected, not a defect, but worth a note in tests/README.md for anyone overriding addopts.
description: snowflake/connector/options.py sets os.environ["ARROW_DEFAULT_MEMORY_POOL"] = "system" the first time it is imported. The test suite's process-state leak guard then reports "test leaked process state past teardown (restored): env[ARROW_DEFAULT_MEMORY_POOL]" on whichever test triggered that import. The result depends on test order: a full CI run usually imports the connector in an earlier test, but running tests/unit/core/results/test_database.py alone errors at teardown of its first test. Fix by importing the connector (or setting the variable) once at session start in the test bootstrap, or by allow-listing this variable in the leak guard with a comment naming the library that sets it.
